subject: general
question: A ________ is a deposit account opted for by many who wish to save a certain part of their earnings.
solution:
The correct answer is __**savings account.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **savings account** is a **deposit account** that allows individuals to **save a certain part of their earnings.**
 
• It is a type of account offered by **banks and financial institutions** that pays interest on the **deposited amount.**
 
• The interest rate may vary depending on the **bank and the balance** in the account.
 
• A savings account provides easy **accessibility to funds,** and individuals can **withdraw money** whenever they need it without any penalty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Share, loan, and debenture are **not deposit** accounts.
 
• Shares represent** ownership in a company,** a loan is** borrowed money **that needs to be repaid with interest, and debentures are a** type of bond** that companies issue to raise capital.
